name: Module 5 lab: scripted summaries and fact-check verdicts for the sample policy-change notices

json.summary: From 15 March the VPN client must be version 6 or later; older versions are disconnected. Get the new client from the Najm Software Catalogue. If it still fails, raise a Network ticket with the error code.
claims: From 15 March the VPN client must be version 6 or later.
Staff on older versions will be disconnected.
The new client is in the Najm Software Catalogue.

json.summary: From 15 March the VPN client must be version 6 or later; older versions are disconnected, after a 30-day grace period. Get the new client from the Najm Software Catalogue.
claims: From 15 March the VPN client must be version 6 or later.
Staff on older versions will be disconnected.
There is a 30-day grace period.
The new client is in the Najm Software Catalogue.

json.summary: From 1 March passwords must be at least 14 characters, up from 12. Reset them at the self-service portal with the authenticator app. The Service Desk never asks for a password by email.
claims: Passwords must be at least 14 characters from 1 March.
The previous minimum was 12 characters.
Passwords are reset at the self-service portal with the authenticator app.
The Service Desk never asks for a password by email.

json.summary: From 1 April report every suspicious email with the Report Phishing button and never forward it. If you clicked a link or opened an attachment, call the Security Operations hotline at once; your device is isolated until checked.
claims: Suspicious emails must be reported with the Report Phishing button from 1 April.
Suspicious emails must not be forwarded to colleagues or the Service Desk.
Staff who clicked a link must call the Security Operations hotline at once.
The device is isolated until checked. [mock:overloaded]

json.summary: Only software from the Najm Software Catalogue may be installed. From 1 May unapproved software is removed during audits, and contractors are exempt. Other software needs approval from Information Security and a licence owner.
claims: Only software from the Najm Software Catalogue may be installed.
From 1 May unapproved software is removed during audits.
Contractors are exempt from the audit removals.
Other software needs approval from Information Security and a licence owner.

json.summary: Laptops are refreshed every 4 years. If one fails earlier, raise a Hardware ticket; a loan device is issued the same day when available. Engineering staff can request a high-spec model with a written justification.
claims: Laptops are refreshed every 4 years.
A failed laptop is handled through a Hardware ticket, with a same-day loan device when available.
Engineering staff may request a high-spec model with a written justification.
